newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up on general election hope.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up on general election hope.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended up on Sunday on fresh buying by local investors after government's assurance that general elections would be held on schedule on February 3, dealers said.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index ended 6.68 points, or 0.49 percent, up at 1,377.01 amid 106 losers and 98 gainers on 29 million shares' trade, up from 23 million on Thursday before the Friday-Saturday weekend.
Government's assurance on polls had removed an uncertainty among investors and a number of them had now returned to the ring, one dealer said.
One floor broker said investors felt there was a possibility that the Pakistan Muslim League party of former prime minister Nawaz Sharif, a businessman, would win the elections.
Pakistan State Oil rose 4.00 rupees to 273, HUBCO 0.50 to 32.80, PTCL 0.40 to 25.90, Nishat Mills 0.90 to 17.40, Millat Tractors 2.00 to 49 and Bank of Punjab 0.50 to 17.
